in_marathi.name: Gavya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gavya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'gau' meaning 'cow'. The name 'Gavya' is a feminine form, and it symbolizes the nourishing and giving nature of a cow. In Hindu mythology, it is also associated with the goddess Kamadhenu, who is considered the source of all riches and nourishment.
